newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 908 million yuan from 1.647 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.

Trading was thin with most head offices of state-run banks staying on the sidelines due to expectations that with inflation likely to fall further this year, interbank rates will also be kept low, traders said.
China's retail price inflation was 6.1 percent last year and the market expects it to fall to five percent this year, traders said.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the most active traders today, traders said.
They said the bullish domestic A share markets spurred some non-banking financial centres to borrow actively from the short-term financial centres.
Traders said they believe the rates will move around current levels in the next few days if the A share markets continue their bull run.
